description: Accounting ledger grid: debit/credit/running-balance columns with exact decimal money rendering via TmMoneyDisplay, server-side paging and aggregation through ILedgerDataProvider, filter-wide footer totals, search plus match-state and currency filters, and a row-matching workflow (pair/unpair with Matched/PartiallyMatched states) when the provider implements ILedgerMatchingProvider.

parameters.name: Provider
parameters.description: Data source of the grid. Use InMemoryLedgerDataProvider for demos and tests; implement ILedgerMatchingProvider to enable the matching UI.

parameters.name: ShowFilters
parameters.description: Whether the search and filter controls are shown.

parameters.name: ShowFooter
parameters.description: Whether the footer with filter-wide debit/credit/balance totals is shown.

parameters.name: ShowRunningBalance
parameters.description: Whether the running balance column (opening balance + cumulative page movements) is shown.

parameters.name: OnEntrySelected
parameters.description: Raised when a row is clicked.

parameters.name: OnMatchingChanged
parameters.description: Raised after entries were matched or unmatched.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.
